source.text:
Location: Gipuzkoa, Spain (CET) Remote: Yes, remote only (contractor or EOR) Willing to relocate: No Technologies: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Claude API, AWS Bedrock, RAG, LangGraph, LLM evals, SQLite/Postgres, Docker, GitHub Actions, TypeScript Résumé/CV: https://emanuelecz.dev Email: emanuelecz06@gmail.com

I built and run Zuvio (https://zuvioai.com), an AI tutor that teaches step by step on a board in 8 languages, on the web and as a native iPhone app. I built it in a month by directing AI coding agents: 407 merged PRs, each planned, reviewed and tested by me, with a fact-check on every lesson, passkey sign-up, Paddle billing and Sentry/Grafana monitoring.

To be upfront: I made the decisions about the code and let the AI write it, and I'm now reviewing all of it myself before the full launch. Before Zuvio I wrote a RAG assistant by hand (github.com/emanuelecz/rag_project).

Looking for a remote AI product engineer or Python backend role. Overlap with UK and US East Coast hours.
